snapshot.text: Tax-funded public system with free care for citizens and a high burden of non-communicable disease. The health ministry proposed a B$646 million budget and Brunei formally recognised obesity as a non-communicable disease in 2026.

priorities.title: Obesity as a disease
priorities.text: Obesity is now recognised as a non-communicable disease.

priorities.title: One Health
priorities.text: A One Health workshop prioritised zoonotic diseases for preparedness.
